summary: A vessel fails at a weld. The fabrication records for that shop covering that period were destroyed in a flood eleven years before the event. No party retained a copy.

signal_basis.prior_report: the records do not exist. Not searched-and-absent

authoring_note: The case that separates NOT_DERIVABLE from NOT_FORESEEN. Nothing fired in EITHER case; the difference is entirely whether the record was searched. Collapsing the two files this as genuinely novel, which is the reading that stops anyone looking.
